#!/usr/bin/env bash
# bash の見本
set -euo pipefail
readonly NAME="${1:-default}" COUNT=$((2 + 3 * 4))
declare -a items=("a b" 'c' $'d\te')
declare -A map=([key]=value [other]="x y")

log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$*" >&2; }

function cleanup {
  local dir=${TMPDIR:?}/work
  [[ -d $dir ]] && command rm -rf -- "${dir:?}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT

for f in ./*.txt "${items[@]+"${items[@]}"}"; do
  case "$f" in
    *.txt|*.md) log "text: ${f%.*} ${f##*/} ${#f}" ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
done

while IFS=: read -r user _ uid _; do
  if (( uid >= 1000 )) && [[ $user =~ ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*$ ]]; then
    echo "user=$user uid=$uid"
  fi
done < /etc/passwd

cat <<-HEREDOC | sed 's/^/  /'
	heredoc with $NAME and $(echo sub) and `echo backtick`
	HEREDOC
cat <<'RAW'
raw $NOT_EXPANDED
RAW
result=$(grep -c "pattern" <(ls -1) 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "${result:-0}" | tee >(wc -c) > /dev/null
arr+=("x"); unset 'arr[0]'; export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH"
echo "閉じない文字列
